messages:
nisha: deploy-bot paused the promotion during the change window. Reason: SBOM signature mismatch + vulnerability scan failed for artifact edge-proxy@sha256:9a7b6c5d. CI: https://ci.redwood.example/runs/135790
deploy-bot: Promotion paused: reason=sbom_signature_mismatch, artifact=edge-proxy@sha256:9a7b6c5d, scan_status=failed, auto_retries=0
nisha: logs snippet:
```
ERROR sbom-verifier: signature verification failed for sbom://artifacts/edge-proxy/sha256:9a7b6c5d
WARN vuln-scan: critical vuln CVE-2033-4488 detected in layer: /usr/lib/libcrypto.so
```
qa-bot: Quick context: the SBOM was uploaded by the build pipeline but signed by CI ephemeral key. We expect signature to be from release-signer service. This looks like a signing step skipped or a signer key mismatch.
ty: Change window ends in 21m. Options: (1) hold + rerun signing step and rescans (20-40m), (2) manual promote previous safe artifact (fast), (3) bypass signature check (not allowed w/ compliance). Thoughts?
devops-lead: Bypass is not an option. We need to weigh missing the window vs compliance. What does last-known-good look like?
nisha: last-known-good stable is edge-proxy@sha256:4f3e2d1c promoted ~4h ago. No open security alerts for that version.
srebot: Security policy: cannot promote unsigned artifact to stable. Manual promote of previous signed artifact is allowed. Creating security ticket: SEC-2026-089.
qa-bot: I'd favor manual-pin to previous signed artifact to keep window. Then run a debug/repair on the signing pipeline and rerun CI for the new build post-window. If vulnerability scan still flags CVE-2033-4488, escalate to security and product.
ty: Agreed. Manual pin + follow-up. Need approver to run promote. @devops-lead?
devops-lead: I approve manual pin. I'll run promote and annotate release notes with the reason and SEC ticket. Command: `deployctl promote --artifact edge-proxy@sha256:4f3e2d1c --target=stable --reason "SBOM/signing mismatch; security policy restricts unsigned promotes" --annotate "Pinned to previous signed artifact; follow-up SEC-2026-089"`
deploy-bot: Promotion scheduled by devops-lead. stable -> edge-proxy@sha256:4f3e2d1c. Release metadata updated.
nisha: change window unblocked. Creating follow-ups: (1) TKT-9001 "repair signing pipeline & validate signer keys", (2) RERUN-9002 "rescan and rerun CI for edge-proxy@9a7b6c5d post-fix".
srebot: SEC-2026-089 created and linked to TKT-9001. Notifying security oncall.
qa-bot: Action items: rerun full CI for the unsigned build after signing fix; if CVE remains, coordinate with security to decide patch or mitigations.
devops-lead: I'll update release notes: "Pinned edge-proxy to previously signed artifact due to SBOM signature mismatch and failing vuln scan; follow-ups SEC-2026-089, TKT-9001, RERUN-9002." Closing thread 1:rocket:
